'''Nicholas Ciuffreda''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[April 2001 Livingston tournament]] on 28 April 2001 with TTO Build the DS2 deck, according to Michael Robinson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2177">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-29-new-world-manga-nj-4-28-01d2177/ new-world-manga-nj-4-28-01], DeckTech (Michael "Bobafett465" Robinson, 29 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-29-new-world-manga-nj-4-28-01d2177/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
